title: Feature request: Add a meal type/category for Carbs treatments
symptom: The user wants to register not only the number of carbs but also a configurable meal type/category (e.g., 'pasta' or 'rice') for later analysis and comparison of bolus styles. Currently, only the number of carbs can be entered.
fix: The maintainer suggests that the requested functionality is already available via the note feature: you can add a note to a treatment by tapping on it and selecting 'Add note', and there is an option under the main menu to search notes.
evidence_quote: You can add a note to a treatment.  Just tap on the treatment.  An option "Add note" will appear at the bottom of the screen for a few seconds.  if you tap on it, you will be able to add a note.
